sfx.costHint: Up to 30 s. Every sound costs as much as 30 s would: the model renders the full length and cuts it. Fewer steps are faster and rougher; guidance 1 halves the work and follows the prompt more loosely.
sfx.defaultPrompt: A heavy wooden door creaks open slowly in a stone hallway, then shuts with a dull thud
sfx.evicts: Rendering evicts resident instances — the first sound takes a while, then they reload.
sfx.none: No text-to-sound-effects model fits on these cards.
sfx.promptHint: Describe the sound, where it happens and how it moves — in English or Chinese, the two languages the model understands.
